# SheetJS Community Edition

Version 0.20.3, Apache-2.0. The license is retained in LICENSE.sheetjs.

Downloaded without modifications from:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

Official installation documentation:
https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

The library is served with the site; importing a spreadsheet does not contact the CDN.
